incoming.name: Oxyrhynchus
incoming.excerpt: During the Greek and Roman periods, Oxyrhynchus had temples to Serapis, Zeus- Amun, Hera-Isis, Atargatis- Bethnnis and Osiris.

outgoing.name: Harvest
outgoing.excerpt: This combination, Osiris-Horus, was therefore a life-death-rebirth deity, and thus associated with the new harvest each year.

outgoing.name: Vowel
outgoing.excerpt: The name was first recorded in Egyptian hieroglyphs only as ws-ir or os-ir because the Egyptian writing system omitted vowels.
